reason: Owns the ordinary Engagement screen: tab/scope selection, existing client/meeting reads and composition of separately owned child workflows. The new outer EngagementScreen separates rich route discrimination before these queries mount; this function contains no rich document retrieval, persistence, renderer or dispatch implementation. The keyed Outreach child disposes selection on destination replacement. The 130-line body is predominantly existing tab composition; splitting it solely for size would obscure the single screen lifetime. See docs/newsletter-port-20261012/evidence/rich-slice-review/STRUCTURE-REVIEW.md#ordinaryengagementscreen.
